responsibility: This file is the CHECKING_P selftest translation unit for GCC’s fibonacci_heap template defined in fibonacci_heap.h. It does not provide the heap algorithms themselves; instead it exercises empty-heap behavior, insertion/extract-min ordering, key replacement, duplicate keys, heap union, and non-scalar key types, validating the meldable priority-queue implementation and its optional pool-based node allocation support.
same_name_distinction: Is only the CHECKING_P selftest translation unit for the same-stem heap template, exercising heap operations and pool-allocation scenarios; the actual fibonacci_node and fibonacci_heap implementation lives in gcc/fibonacci_heap.h.
